App crashes frequently when I try to view my portfolio. This has been happening for the past week and it's very frustrating. I cannot track my investments properly. Please fix this critical issue urgently.

Decent app overall. Does what it's supposed to do but nothing extraordinary. Some features are good while others need improvement. The mutual fund section is well designed but stocks could be better organized.

Good app with easy to navigate interface. A few minor bugs here and there but nothing major that breaks functionality. Would recommend to friends who are looking to start investing in mutual funds and stocks.

Terrible experience with this app. Customer support is non-existent and the app keeps logging me out randomly. Lost money because of bugs in the order execution. Do not recommend this app to anyone who values their investments.

apple_store_raw.review: Absolutely love this app! Best investment platform I've used. Fast execution, reliable performance, and intuitive design. Customer support is also very responsive when needed.
